attempts.summary: Configured a root crontab entry on node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified the binary runs successfully and writes to the log. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy state, issued a native reboot, polled until the node came back, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified cron service, crontab entry, log contents, and binary all persisted post-restart.
